title: Acceptance and Application of Payments on a Patient Payment Plan
content:
**Patient Accounts cashiering policy — payments on a Patient Payment Plan**

**1. Plans that accept payments.** Payments are accepted only on a Patient Payment Plan in active, past due or defaulted status. The status is the one shown on that agreement's record before the payment is taken.

**2. Methods.** Payments are made by card, ACH, check, cash, or an HSA or FSA card where the tier accepts HSA and FSA cards.

**3. Automatic collection (retired clause).** The clause "where the tier requires automatic payment, installments are collected automatically and manual payments are extra" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of the Patient Payment Plan.

**4. Order of application.** A payment is applied first to the oldest unpaid installment, then to plan fees, then as principal. An amount above what is due is applied as the tier's handling of overpayments provides.

**5. Extra principal (retired clause).** The clause "extra principal shortens the remaining term where the tier so provides and otherwise lowers the installment" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis.

**6. When an installment counts as paid.** An installment counts as paid when at least the tier's part-payment share of it is paid by the end of the grace period.

**7. Payoff.** A payment that brings the balance to zero pays the plan off.

## Status table for clause 1

Clause 1 is a complete list, so every other status is outside it.

| Agreement status | Payment accepted |
|---|---|
| Pending signature | No |
| Active | Yes |
| Past due | Yes |
| Defaulted | Yes |
| Paid off | No |
| Cancelled | No |

## Application under clause 4 (hypothetical figures)

A plan has one unpaid installment of 50.00 and an outstanding plan fee of 10.00, and the patient pays 80.00. The payment covers the unpaid installment (50.00), then the fee (10.00), and the remaining 20.00 is applied as principal.

## Clause 6 (hypothetical figures)

For a tier whose part-payment share is 100 percent, an installment of 60.00 counts as paid only when 60.00 has been paid by the end of the grace period; 59.99 does not meet it. For a tier whose share is 50 percent, 30.00 paid by then meets it.

superseded_clauses: where autopay_required is true installments are collected automatically and manual payments are extra.
and extra principal shortens the remaining term where extra_payment_shortens_term is true and otherwise lowers the installment.
